overview.title: Overview
overview.zeroNone: No searches without results in the period.

queue.title: Moderation queue
queue.lead: Oldest submissions come first. Open one to compare before and after.
queue.emptyBody: No submissions waiting for review right now.

review.checkInValue: {{distance}} m from the centre · accuracy {{accuracy}} m
review.lowAccuracyBody: The check-in used imprecise GPS. Use the photos to confirm the submission is really from the market.
review.conflictsTitle: The data changed after this submission
review.conflictsBody: Another approved submission changed these items. Approve only if this submission is still right.
review.acceptConflicts: I checked the conflicts and want to apply this submission anyway.
review.problemNotConfirmed: The collaborator did not find the problem.
review.ownSubmission: This is your own submission. Someone else in moderation needs to review it.
review.approved: Submission approved. The data is live.
review.rejected: Submission rejected. The collaborator was notified.
review.rejectBody: The reason and the comment are shown to the collaborator.
review.commentHint: Say what was missing so the next submission gets approved.
review.reopen: Reopen the task for someone else
review.error: We couldn't finish the review. Refresh the page and try again.

reports.title: Reports
reports.lead: When a stall reaches the report limit, a check task opens on its own. Here you can open one sooner or dismiss.
reports.emptyBody: Reports from the public show up in this list.
reports.error: We couldn't finish that right now.

suggestions.title: Product suggestions
suggestions.lead: Products collaborators didn't find on the list. Approve to add to the catalog or merge with an existing one.
suggestions.approved: Product approved. Complete the translations in the catalog.
suggestions.emptyBody: When a collaborator suggests a product, it shows up here.
suggestions.error: We couldn't finish that right now.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.lead: Create tasks, publish those on hold and cancel those that no longer make sense. Each stall has at most one active task.
tasks.createBody: The task opens if there is budget; without budget, it goes on hold.
tasks.emptyBody: Change the filters or create a task.
tasks.error: We couldn't finish that right now.

markets.title: Markets
markets.lead: Position, check-in radius and texts of each market. The Feira da 25 position is approximate: check it on the map.
markets.name: Name
markets.radiusHint: Between 50 and 2000 m from the centre.
markets.radiusError: Use a radius between 50 and 2000 m.
markets.translationsNote: English and Spanish texts are kept as they are.
markets.error: We couldn't save. Someone may have changed the market; refresh the page.
markets.mapLabel: Map of {{name}}: tap to move the centre
markets.mapHint: Tap the map to move the centre. The circle shows the {{radius}} m radius.

stalls.title: Stalls
stalls.lead: Details, section, status and consent of each stall.
stalls.editBody: Changes go live right away and are recorded in the audit log.
stalls.consentRevoked: The vendor revoked consent. The stall is offline and its photos will be deleted.
stalls.revoked: Consent revoked. The stall is offline.
stalls.emptyBody: Change the market or the search.
stalls.error: We couldn't save. Refresh the page and try again.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.lead: Name, description and synonyms of each product in the 3 languages. Synonyms help search find the product.
catalog.editBody: Changes apply to search and to the next offline copies of the markets.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.aliasesHint: Separate with commas. E.g. cassava, manioc
catalog.emptyBody: Change the status or the search.
catalog.error: We couldn't save. Someone may have changed the product; refresh the page.

finance.title: Finance
finance.lead: Commissions, budget and payouts. Payment happens outside the platform; here it is only recorded.
finance.used: Share of the budget already used
finance.noBudget: No budget this month: new tasks stay on hold until there is money or they are published as volunteer.
finance.amountError: Write the amount with numbers only, for example 25.00.
finance.noBalancesBody: When a collaborator reaches the minimum, they show up here.
finance.payoutBody: Make the payment at the bank and record it here. The record creates the entry in the collaborator's statement.
finance.revealAudit: Viewing the key is recorded in the audit log.
finance.rulesHint: a new rule applies from now on
finance.error: We couldn't finish that right now.

users.title: Users
users.lead: Role and status of each account. Every change goes to the audit log.
users.emptyBody: Change the search or the role.

audit.title: Audit
audit.lead: Record of who did what and when. Read only.
